mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_review (user_id, spu_id, sku_id, order_id, order_no, rating, content, pics, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{userId}, #{spuId}, #{skuId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{pics}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_review SET reply = #{reply}, reply_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stellar_review SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS username FROM stellar_review r LEFT JOIN stellar_mall_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.spu_id = #{spuId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_review WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM stellar_review WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM stellar_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND spu_id = #{spuId}
